|game_text=Deploy on table. Non-unique aliens are immune to [[Grimtaash]] (While you have < 13 cards in hand) , [[The Camp (V){{!}}The Camp]], and deployment conditions on [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]]. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p3-15-Well_Guarded-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-wellguarded-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-15-Well_Guarded.png]]) show the original text (see [[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. [Immune to Alter]” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-wellguarded-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-15-Well_Guarded.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 33) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Your non-unique aliens” to “Non-unique aliens” and “deployment costs” to “deployment conditions” (and printed “(While you have < 13 cards in hand) ,” as published)<ref name="cl-1281_15-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (While you have < 13 cards in hand) , The Camp, and deployment conditions on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to Alter.)” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-15-Well_Guarded-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
